name: Mercenary III: The Dion Crisis
storyline:
With the threat of Damocles averted (Mercenary II), the peoples of the Gamma solar system have resumed a peaceful existence; free to continue their life of commerce, politics and the pursuit of pleasure.

You've had some time away from it all, but on your return, you find that all is not well. A sinister character has risen to prominence -- the enigmatic P C Bil. You see beneath his guide of benevolence a boundless ambition that needs to be checked!

Things here have changed. With concern for the environment, new public transport systems have been introduced. Your old friend, the President, has concluded her term of office. There's to be an election. Her legacy, a new economic order, Society is expected to be more self-reliant. But you should be well placed in this scheme of things. You are wealthy enough to go your own way.
summary: Like the previous game in the series, Damocles, the player explores a realtime 3D vector graphics world. The improved game engine features moving road vehicles and spacecraft and interactive NPCs. There are multiple solutions to win the game by preventing the villain from being elected President.
